# EarthPulse Live

EarthPulse Live is a read-only geospatial dashboard for public natural-event data from USGS and NASA EONET.

## Canonical resources

- Dashboard API: `/api/v1/dashboard`
- OpenAPI contract: `/openapi.json`
- API catalog: `/.well-known/api-catalog`
- Agent plugin: `/.well-known/agent-plugin/plugin.json`
- Authentication: `/auth.md`

## Safety and provenance

Data is informational and must not replace official emergency alerts. Every event includes a source, external identifier, occurrence time, and—when supplied by the provider—a source URL. The API is read-only and requires no authentication.
